spans.s:
शीधु शीधु, उस्, उ, m. n. (according to
Uṇādi-s.
IV. 38

. fr. rt. 1. शी, but also written सीधु),
a spirit distilled from molasses, any intoxicating
liquor, rum; wine.
—शीधु-गन्ध, अस्, m. ‘smell-
ing of spirits,’ the Vakula tree, Mimusops Elengi.
—शीधु-प, अस्, ई, अम्, drinking spirits, a drinker
of spirits, dram-drinker.

सीधु सीधु, उस्, m. = शीधु (q. v.), spirit
distilled from molasses, rum (or any similar spirit).
—सीधु-गन्ध, अस्, m. ‘having the smell of
rum,’ the plant or tree Mimusops Elengi (= वकुल).
—सीधु-प, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, drinking spirits.
—सीधु-पुष्प, अस्, m. the Kadamba tree; the
Vakula tree; (ई), f. the Dhātakī plant.
—सीधु-
रस, अस्, m. ‘having spirit-like juice,’ the Mango
tree.
—सीधु-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, m. the Vakula tree.
सिध् 1. सिध् (according to Vopa-deva
VIII. 41

. the स् of this rt. is not changed
to ष् after prepositions; cf. परि-सिध्), cl. 1. P.
सेधति, सिषेध, सेधिष्यति, असेधीत्, सेधि-
तुम्, to go, (in Naigh.
II. 14

. सेधति is enume-
rated among the गति-कर्माणः); to go towards,
reach, strike, hit (Ved.).

सिध् 2. सिध् (this rt. allows the change
of स् to ष् after prepositions, cf. प्रति-
षिध्), cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) सेधति (-ते), सि-
षेध, सेत्स्यति or सेधिष्यति, असैत्सीत् or असे-
धीत्, सेद्धुम् or सेधितुम्, to drive off, ward off,
keep off, restrain, hinder; to interdict; to ordain,
instruct; to turn out well or auspiciously: Caus.
सेधयति, -यितुम्: Desid. of Caus. सिषेधयि-
षति: Desid. सिसेधिषति, सिसिधिषति, सिषित्-
सति: Intens. सेषिध्यते, सेषेद्धि.

सिध् 3. सिध् (connected with rt. साध्),
cl. 4. P. सिध्यति (ep. also A. -ते), सि-
षेध, सेत्स्यति, असिधत्, सेद्धुम्, to be accom-
plished, be fulfilled, be effected; to be successful,
succeed; to be settled or established; to be valid;
to be proved or demonstrated; to be thoroughly
prepared or cooked; to attain an object, hit an aim,
fall true (with loc., e. g. इषुः सिध्यति लक्ष्ये,
the arrow falls true on the mark): Pass. सिध्यते,
Aor. असेधि, to be completed or concluded, &c.:
Caus. सेधयति, with reference to sacred things;
साधयति, -यितुम्, with reference to secular things,
(Pāṇ.

; see rt. साध्); to accomplish,
complete, effect, settle, perform: Desid. सिषित्सति:
Intens. सेषिध्यते, सेषेद्धि.

सिधित्वा, ind. (according to some) = सिद्ध्वा
above.

सिध्म, अम्, or सिध्मन्, अ, n. a blotch, pustule,
scab; pock-mark, leprous spot; leprosy or a kind of
leprosy (one of the seven kinds).
—सिध्म-पुष्-
पिका, f. a particular kind of cutaneous disease or
leprosy.
—सिध्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, scabby, pock-
marked, covered with pustules or blotches; leprous,
tainted with leprosy.
सिध्मा, f. a blotch, scab, leprous spot; leprosy.

सिध्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, = सिध्म-वत्; (आ), f. a
scab, blotch, leprous spot; a sort of leprosy; dried
fish, salt fish (= मत्स्य-विकृति).

सिध्य, अस्, m. ‘auspicious,’ N. of the asterism
Puṣya.

सिध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. obtaining, effecting,
(Sāy. = साधक); perfect, good; protecting; (अस्),
m. a pious or virtuous man; a tree.

सीध्र सीध्र, अम्, n. (according to some)
the anus.

सिध्रका, f. a kind of plant or tree.
—सिध्रका-
वण, अम्, n. ‘Sidhrakā-grove,’ N. of one of the
celestial gardens.
